dedupe_keys.name: arcep gabon market observatories for internet fixed and mobile quarterly

description: ARCEP Gabon publishes quarterly market observatories for three markets: internet, fixed telephony and mobile telephony. The internet observatory page lists 31 files, PDFs and zipped copies, from about the fourth quarter of 2023 to the fourth quarter of 2025; the fixed and mobile pages follow the same pattern. The observatories report subscribers, traffic, revenue and market shares of operators such as Airtel Gabon and Moov Africa Gabon Telecom. Coverage: Gabon, national totals by quarter and operator. Format and access: PDF files and ZIP archives on the ARCEP website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the ZIP archives appear to hold the same PDF; file names are inconsistent; older quarters may be missing; the reports were not opened, so the indicator list is inferred. Simulation uses: quarterly subscriber and traffic series for Gabonese telecom capacity planning and resilience studies. Related records: data-itu-ict-statistics gives annual national series; data-arcep-togo-electronic-communications-market-observatory is a similar observatory from Togo.
licence: not stated (no licence or terms statement on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
